desc: Ideation and derivation of the row/column parity + B-cell equation reduction.
Implement fast input parsing for T test cases with total H W <= 1e6.
For each case, check every row and every column has an even number of 'A'; output 0 if any is odd.
Build a DSU with xor parity over H row nodes and W column nodes.
Process cells with prefix parities: for each B at (i,j), union row i and column j with constant k = 1 xor col_parity[j] xor row_pref; for each A, toggle row_pref and col_parity[j].
If any B equation contradicts an existing DSU parity, output 0; otherwise output 2^{number of DSU components over all H+W nodes} mod 998244353.
Test on the sample input and additional edge cases (all A, all B, inconsistent parity equations) -- sample passed.
